# A pane scrolled back into copy mode, then moved by its title bar and let go
# off the pane. The release took the copy-mode selection branch, which ends a
# text selection and returns, so the move never finished and the pane kept
# IsBeingManipulated: it stopped drawing new output and kept the idle tick
# busy. A selection never sets that mark, so the branch now takes only a
# gesture that did not move the pane.
focus 2
zoom
layout 2
zoom
focus 0
move 1
burst 75 1
wheel 36 2 0
press 25 0 1
release 0 0 1
